visual_candidates.question: 这一期可比较的核心指标是什么？
visual_candidates.rationale: Both flow years and balance dates must be explicit

visual_candidates.question: 法定收入如何逐层形成归母利润？
visual_candidates.rationale: All six consolidated source lines required; V3 can still refuse negative layouts

visual_candidates.question: 哪些互斥业务真实留下毛利？
visual_candidates.rationale: Missing separate segment rows or paired parent statement amounts

visual_candidates.question: 在同一累计期间，哪些损益项目增速分化？
visual_candidates.rationale: Require comparable positive reference-year flow values; this does not imply a quarterly trend

visual_candidates.question: 利润率和费用率如何变化？
visual_candidates.rationale: Negative ratios must fall back to signed bridges, not positive-only dumbbells

visual_candidates.question: 资产和负债余额相对年初怎样变化？
visual_candidates.rationale: Balance changes are snapshots, not CFO components or Y/Y flow growth

visual_candidates.question: 单季走势是在加速还是放缓？
visual_candidates.rationale: At least three distinct, independently sourced single quarters are needed

research_questions.source_caveat: Product/channel economics: require a proven mutually exclusive partition
Reconcile exceptional gains, tax and minority interest
Use full CFO reconciliation if disclosed; never infer causality from stocks
Investigate working capital, capex and restricted cash
